product_lane: Track A Launch-Now / Zero-Possession document integrity
value_proposition: Let a user locally fingerprint a document and obtain a server-signed technical integrity receipt without EvidenceOps taking possession of the document bytes, while keeping statutory certification claims separate and gated.
target_user: individual or institution needing tamper-evident copy-integrity assurance and verifiable receipt evidence
safe_public_claim: Technical document-integrity assurance with signed receipt verification; not statutory certification, issuer verification or government affiliation unless separately proven.
truth_boundary: Targets are pilot hypotheses. Null observed values mean no pilot result exists. A pilot cannot be declared successful until all mandatory metrics are observed and pass, provider/runtime evidence is independently read back where applicable, and legal/public wording remains within the Track A truth boundary.
